# PathWeave — full reference

> PathWeave is a management consulting and advisory firm founded in April 2020. It helps founders and leadership teams strengthen the systems behind growth: sales processes, CRM, data and dashboards, HR and people systems, roles, operating routines and execution. Website: https://pathweave.in/

This file summarises facts published on pathweave.in. Where it quotes outcomes from a founder's earlier career, those are employer results from before PathWeave, not PathWeave client results. Last reviewed: 8 October 2026.

## Identity

- Official name: PathWeave
- Brand line: Strategy. Transformation. Growth.
- Type: Management consulting and advisory firm
- Founded: April 2020
- Website: https://pathweave.in/
- Email: growth@pathweave.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77008 83315
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pathweave-consulting
- Geography: PathWeave works with organisations across India. Current on-ground presence includes Hyderabad, Nagpur and Bhopal, with remote consulting support where appropriate.

## Positioning

Growth problems are often systems problems. PathWeave works on connected people, processes, data, technology and execution rather than treating them as isolated functional fixes. It works mainly with growing SMEs, promoter-led companies and mid-market businesses moving from founder-led decisions to structured management.

## Framework: PW-3 Sutra

People, Process and Technology are designed together:
- People: roles, ownership, capability and the leaders who run the change.
- Process: workflows, reviews and decision rights that make work repeatable.
- Technology: CRM, HR systems, data and dashboards that make work visible.

## Method

Diagnose → Design → Implement → Enable → Measure. PathWeave diagnoses before prescribing, designs for the real organisation, supports implementation where required, builds ownership with the client team, and sets practical measures for adoption and outcomes.

## PeopleOS — people and HR transformation
https://pathweave.in/peopleos/

PeopleOS treats HR as part of the operating system of a growing business: organisation structure, role clarity, manager capability, performance, recruitment, HR operations, HR technology and service ownership are designed as connected parts.

### Flagship PeopleOS pillar

HR Consulting for SMEs — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-smes/

This is the broadest PeopleOS growth-stage pillar. It helps growing SMEs move from informal founder-led people decisions toward a practical people operating system without importing unnecessary large-company bureaucracy. It covers:
- organisation structure and role clarity;
- manager responsibilities and capability;
- performance management;
- recruitment and onboarding;
- HR operations and employee lifecycle;
- HRMS and people data;
- HR operating-model choices;
- the appropriate mix of internal HR, fractional HR and outsourced support.

PathWeave uses a practical SME growth-stage framework: approximately 1–20 employees for foundations, 20–50 for process consistency, 50–100 for clearer HR ownership and manager systems, 100–200 for operating-model and performance governance, and 200+ for more specialist HR capability and transformation. These are practical guides rather than statutory thresholds.

### PeopleOS industry sub-pillars

HR Consulting for Startups — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-startups/
- stage-appropriate people foundations;
- first hires and role clarity;
- repeatable recruitment and onboarding;
- first-time manager capability;
- lightweight performance systems;
- HR ownership as the company scales.

HR Consulting for Pharma & Life Sciences — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-pharma-life-sciences/
- workforce planning across specialist and multi-location contexts;
- organisation and role clarity;
- specialist recruitment;
- performance and capability systems;
- multi-location HR operations;
- HRMS and people data.
This page describes PeopleOS people/HR capability and does not claim pharmaceutical regulatory consulting or unverified pharma client delivery.

HR Consulting for IT & Technology — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-it-technology/
- specialist hiring;
- role and career architecture;
- technical versus managerial progression;

- HRMS and workforce data.
This page describes PeopleOS capability and does not claim unverified technology-sector client outcomes.

HR Consulting for GCCs — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-gccs/

This page is specifically about people strategy, organisation and HR operating systems for GCCs. It does not position PathWeave as providing entity incorporation, tax, transfer pricing, immigration, company-law or regulatory-approval services.

### Shared PeopleOS functional authority

HR Transformation — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-transformation/
Redesign of HR operating models, processes, governance, technology, data, manager routines and adoption.

HR Operating Model — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-operating-model/
Clarifies the HR mandate, manager responsibilities, service boundaries, decision rights, governance and the right internal/fractional/outsourced capacity mix.

Organisation Design & Role Clarity — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/organisation-design-role-clarity/
Structures, role purpose, accountabilities, spans, layers, decision rights and cross-functional interfaces.

Performance Management — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/performance-management/
Clear expectations, manager check-ins, evidence, calibration, development and consequences/recognition built around a management rhythm rather than an annual form.

HR Operations & HRMS — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-operations-hrms/
Practical HR processes, employee data, HRMS requirements, reporting, workflows and automation.

Recruitment & Talent — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/recruitment-talent/
Role definition, recruitment process, assessment, hiring workflows and onboarding support.

Fractional HR — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/fractional-hr/
Experienced HR leadership without the commitment of a full-time senior hire.

HR Outsourcing — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-outsourcing/
Defined external support across recurring HR operations, recruitment and employee lifecycle work.

## Focused entry offers

- HR Health Check — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-health-check/ — review one HR area such as HR operations, policies and compliance, performance management, recruitment, organisation and role clarity, HRMS or employee lifecycle. Small fixed price agreed upfront.
- Sales & CRM Health Check — https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-crm-health-check/ — one sales/CRM focus. Small fixed price agreed upfront.
- Free readiness assessment — https://pathweave.in/diagnostic/ — 15 questions, about 5 minutes, indicative scores across People, Process and Technology; responses are calculated in the browser.

## Founders

### Srrinivas Sharrma — Founder, leads BusinessOS
https://pathweave.in/about/srrinivas-sharrma/
Business leader with 18+ years across revenue growth, sales transformation, Sales Excellence, Commercial Excellence, sales operations, CRM and go-to-market execution.
- Agro Tech Foods and PepsiCo: frontline and regional sales; at PepsiCo led the Maharashtra premium beverage business (Tropicana, Gatorade, Himalayan); Tropicana market share moved from 44% to 52% in that role.
- Kohler India: led Retail and Projects across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, including 5× retail growth over four years; later national Sales Development, then Business Process Excellence – Commercial. National Salesforce adoption covered four regions, 150+ Sales and Marketing employees and 500+ dealers.
- Info Edge (Naukri.com): Senior Vice President – Sales Planning & Excellence; led Microsoft Dynamics CRM adoption across 700+ sales users and 11 branches.

Authority evidence pages:
